addition: Stages 4--6 replace the I3D RoI features used in Stages 2 and 3 with features extracted from cropped video clips. Here, a crop is a rectangular image region centered on a candidate box and enlarged to include nearby context. During detector evaluation, these boxes come from the fixed YOLO detections; head-training crops use training-split ground-truth boxes and background examples. Each crop clip is encoded separately by the frozen InternVideo2 visual tower to produce a feature vector for event classification.
